fields.sequence: non-negative integer decoded from the record
fields.calibrated: decimal string with exactly three fractional digits, rounded with IEEE 754 round-half-even

events_jsonl.record_order: ascending by session, then timestamp_ms, then sequence, then channel

calibration_json.sessions: object keyed by session in lexicographic insertion order

channel_fields.reference_low: decimal string copied from the ledger in normalized form with exactly three fractional digits
channel_fields.reference_high: decimal string copied from the ledger in normalized form with exactly three fractional digits
channel_fields.gain: decimal string with exactly nine fractional digits, rounded half-even
channel_fields.offset: decimal string with exactly nine fractional digits, rounded half-even

session_fields.capture_sha256: lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the complete input capture
session_fields.firmware: legacy, modern, or mixed according to valid records
session_fields.valid_frames: count of records with recognized framing, a supported type, the declared payload size, and a valid trailer
session_fields.rejected_frames: count of complete sync candidates rejected during recovery; unrelated noise bytes and an incomplete suffix are not candidates
session_fields.first_timestamp_ms: timestamp of the earliest emitted observation
session_fields.last_timestamp_ms: timestamp of the latest emitted observation
